_comment: STAGING AREA, NOT A HOME. Empty, and it should stay that way.
The Bland sync uploads the Kumi feed PLUS anything in here. Kumi is the source
of truth for both bots; this exists only for a fact the phone agent needs
before someone can publish it in Kumi's admin.
The 19 facts that lived here on 9 August 2026 were published in Kumi and
removed from here the same day. While they were in both, every one of them
was uploaded to Bland TWICE. They happened to agree, but the first edit in the
admin would have left a stale copy here and put two contradicting chunks in
front of a caller, with lexical retrieval picking whichever matched their
words. Their permanent home is scripts/seed_voice_knowledge.py in padelclublist.
If you add something here, publish it in Kumi and empty this again. The sync
warns on every run while it is non-empty, for that reason.
